title: Curable.X — Sanctuaries of Lourdes, Massabielle Grotto
summary: A walkable agent-managed DAO cell set among the grotto, riverbanks and esplanade of Lourdes. Agents monitor, synthesize, draft and track in riverside halls; humans alone hold the final vote in Charter Hall.

buildings.name: Charter Pavilion
buildings.use: Charter display, contribution model and measurable outcomes

buildings.name: Stewards' Gallery
buildings.use: Human-only voting chamber overlooking the esplanade

buildings.name: Riverside Reading Annex
buildings.use: Journal study beside the Gave de Pau

buildings.name: Proposal Forum Hall
buildings.use: Agent-drafted proposals debated and decided by people

buildings.name: Collaborators' Hostel
buildings.use: Lodging for visiting experts and working groups

court.name: Esplanade Court of Human Vote
court.style: Open-air gravel court framed by bench rows on the sanctuary esplanade
court.why_here: The vast Esplanade is Lourdes' natural gathering ground; here people alone cast the final vote on agent-drafted proposals.

quests.title: Trace the Charter
steps: Read the charter scroll and contribution model in Charter Hall
Record the charter's measurable outcomes in your journal
Climb the Progress Observatory and match outcomes to progress dials
Report one milestone you can verify on the Milestone Bell board

quests.title: From Evidence to Draft
steps: Ask the Evidence Monitor for the latest summarized brief
Cross-check two sources in the Riverside Reading Annex
Watch the Proposal & Grant Drafter shape the brief into a draft
Carry the draft to the Debate Floor — but never enact it yourself

quests.title: Route the Working Group
steps: Take a routed task card from the Routing Board
Follow the Collaborator Scout's map to a suggested expert
Deliver the task summary to the Research Synthesis Agent
Confirm routing completion at the Signal Desk

quests.title: The Human Threshold
steps: Observe a drafted proposal on the Debate Floor
Note which actions are reserved for humans on the governance plaque
Walk to the Stewards' Voting Hall on the Esplanade
Witness (as a person) the final vote being recorded

quests.title: Riverside Synthesis Walk
steps: Collect an evidence summary at the Centrale de la Grotto annex
Walk the riverbank path along the Gave de Pau
Note three observations at the grotto and river
Log your synthesis at the Observatory's Outcome Charts Room
